sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 120. Success value 70. 10x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Applies bleed to all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 60.
[Additional Unison Effect] Curses all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 60.
[Additional Unison Effect] Applies psychological contamination to all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 60.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 4000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 4000
Only [Serpent Sword] Kohzuchi can be used as Unlocking Potential material
